instruction: Treat tagged_cutout.step as the reference. On this machine, open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Create an outside Profile cutting operation and add six holding tags uniformly around the outer contour. Each tag must be 4 mm wide and 1 mm high, and the final profile bottom must be Z=0. Tool definition: T1 is a 6 mm diameter end mill for outside Profile cutting with six holding tags. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-19.nc.
